title: China's Communist Party elite hold key talks on governance
paragraphs: China's Communist Party elite hold key talks on governance
The fifth plenum comes ahead of a major party congress next year, where Chinese President Xi Jinping is almost certain to secure a historic fourth term and oversee a leadership reshuffle.

BEIJING: China's President Xi Jinping opened a key meeting of Communist Party elites in Beijing on Monday (Oct 26), state media said, which observers will be closely watching for clues as to the country's direction and future leadership.
